# SQL feature support

<!-- Generated by tools/restprobe. Do not edit; run `just docs` to regenerate. -->

This page lists the statements and clauses BigQuery accepts and whether the emulator runs them.
Built-in functions are listed in [functions.md](functions.md), and behavior these tables cannot
show in [compatibility.md](compatibility.md).

`tools/restprobe` runs each query in `tools/sql_features.txt` with jobs.query against the fixture
tables `t (id INT64, name STRING, tags ARRAY<STRING>, s STRUCT<a INT64, b STRING>)` and
`u (id INT64, v INT64)`. A probe checks only that a query translates and runs on DuckDB, not that
it returns what BigQuery would. The notes of a Partial feature list the forms the emulator
rejected.

- **Supported**: every query runs.
- **Partial**: some queries run, and the emulator rejects the others as unsupported.
- **Unsupported**: the emulator rejects every query as unsupported.
- **Broken**: a query translates but fails on DuckDB, which is a bug.

| Section | Supported | Partial | Unsupported |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Queries](#queries) | 29 | 4 | 1 |
| [DML](#dml) | 9 | 0 | 0 |
| [DDL](#ddl) | 15 | 10 | 6 |
| [Multi-statement queries](#multi-statement-queries) | 9 | 4 | 0 |
| [INFORMATION_SCHEMA](#information_schema) | 4 | 0 | 0 |

## Queries

| Feature | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SELECT` without `FROM` | Supported |  |
| Table reads, `WHERE`, `ORDER BY`, `LIMIT` | Supported |  |
| Fully qualified table names | Supported |  |
| `SELECT DISTINCT` | Supported |  |
| Joins | Supported |  |
| `UNNEST` | Supported |  |
| `UNNEST ... WITH OFFSET` | Supported |  |
| `WITH` | Supported |  |
| `WITH RECURSIVE` | Supported |  |
| Subqueries | Supported |  |
| Correlated subqueries | Partial | See [STRUCT values](compatibility.md#struct-values). Unsupported: correlated aggregate subquery with anonymous or duplicate STRUCT fields. |
| Aggregates and `GROUP BY` | Supported |  |
| `GROUP BY ALL` | Supported |  |
| `GROUPING SETS`, `ROLLUP`, `CUBE` | Supported |  |
| Aggregate `ORDER BY` | Supported |  |
| Aggregate `LIMIT` | Supported |  |
| Aggregate `IGNORE NULLS` | Supported |  |
| Aggregate `HAVING MAX` / `MIN` | Partial | Unsupported: aggregate ANY_VALUE with HAVING or GROUP BY. |
| Window functions | Supported |  |
| `QUALIFY` | Supported |  |
| Set operations | Supported |  |
| Set operations `CORRESPONDING` | Supported |  |
| Set operations `BY NAME` | Supported |  |
| `SELECT AS STRUCT`, `SELECT AS VALUE` | Supported |  |
| `* EXCEPT`, `* REPLACE` | Supported |  |
| `.*` of a struct | Supported |  |
| STRUCT constructors and casts | Partial | See [STRUCT values](compatibility.md#struct-values). Unsupported: CAST to JSON with anonymous or duplicate STRUCT fields. |
| Struct field and array element access | Supported |  |
| `PIVOT` | Supported |  |
| `UNPIVOT` | Supported |  |
| `TABLESAMPLE` | Unsupported |  |
| Pipe syntax | Supported |  |
| INTERVAL values | Partial | See [INTERVAL values](compatibility.md#interval-values). Unsupported: aggregate or analytic function ARRAY_AGG with INTERVAL; function JSON_ARRAY with INTERVAL. |
| RANGE values | Supported | See [RANGE values](compatibility.md#range-values). |

## DDL

| Feature | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CREATE TABLE` | Supported |  |
| Column types with parameters | Supported | `STRING(L)` and `BYTES(L)` lose their length. |
| `BIGNUMERIC` columns | Supported |  |
| Column defaults | Supported |  |
| `CREATE TABLE AS SELECT` | Supported |  |
| `CREATE TABLE AS SELECT` with `NOT NULL` | Unsupported |  |
| Table and column options | Supported | See [Options and expiration](compatibility.md#options-and-expiration). |
| Column rounding modes | Partial | See [Rounding modes](compatibility.md#rounding-modes). Unsupported: defaults on parameterized ROUND_HALF_EVEN fields. |
| Default rounding modes | Supported | See [Rounding modes](compatibility.md#rounding-modes). |
| Partitioning and clustering | Partial | See [Partitioning and clustering](compatibility.md#partitioning-and-clustering). Unsupported: CREATE TABLE option require_partition_filter. |
| Primary and foreign keys | Supported | Accepted and dropped. |
| Collation | Unsupported |  |
| `CREATE TEMP TABLE` | Supported | See [Scripts and transactions](compatibility.md#scripts-and-transactions). |
| `CREATE TABLE LIKE` | Partial | See [Copies and clones](compatibility.md#copies-and-clones). Unsupported: CREATE TABLE LIKE AS SELECT with length parameters; CREATE TABLE LIKE AS SELECT with nested NOT NULL. |
| `CREATE TABLE COPY` | Partial | See [Copies and clones](compatibility.md#copies-and-clones). Unsupported: CREATE TABLE COPY with FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF. |
| `CREATE TABLE CLONE` | Partial | See [Copies and clones](compatibility.md#copies-and-clones). Unsupported: CREATE TABLE CLONE with FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF. |
| `CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE` | Unsupported |  |
| `CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE` | Unsupported |  |
| `DROP TABLE` | Supported |  |
| `ALTER TABLE` | Partial | See [ALTER TABLE](compatibility.md#alter-table). Unsupported: ADD COLUMN with generated columns, defaults or NOT NULL. |
| `CREATE SCHEMA` | Partial | See [Datasets](compatibility.md#datasets). Unsupported: BigQuery Omni location aws-us-east-1. |
| `DROP SCHEMA` | Supported |  |
| `ALTER SCHEMA` | Supported | See [Datasets](compatibility.md#datasets). |
| `CREATE VIEW` | Supported | See [Views](compatibility.md#views). |
| `DROP VIEW` | Supported |  |
| `CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW` | Unsupported |  |
| `CREATE FUNCTION` | Partial | See [User-defined functions](compatibility.md#user-defined-functions). Unsupported: JavaScript UDF arguments of type DATE; OR REPLACE and IF NOT EXISTS for temporary SQL UDFs; function IFERROR; persistent non-SQL UDFs; views that call SQL UDFs; volatile SQL UDF arguments with subquery bodies. |
| `DROP FUNCTION` | Supported |  |
| `CREATE TABLE FUNCTION` | Unsupported |  |
| `CREATE PROCEDURE` | Partial | See [Stored procedures](compatibility.md#stored-procedures). Unsupported: procedure arguments other than fixed-type IN arguments; procedures without OPTIONS(strict_mode = FALSE). |
| `DROP PROCEDURE` | Partial | See [Stored procedures](compatibility.md#stored-procedures). Unsupported: persistent routine name missing without a dataset. |

## Multi-statement queries

| Feature | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Statement lists | Supported | See [Scripts and transactions](compatibility.md#scripts-and-transactions). |
| `DECLARE`, `SET` | Supported |  |
| `BEGIN ... END` | Supported |  |
| `BEGIN ... EXCEPTION ... END` | Supported | See [Scripts and transactions](compatibility.md#scripts-and-transactions). |
| `IF` | Supported |  |
| `CASE` | Supported |  |
| Loops | Supported |  |
| `FOR ... IN` | Supported |  |
| `RAISE`, `RETURN` | Supported |  |
| System variables | Partial | See [Scripts and transactions](compatibility.md#scripts-and-transactions). Unsupported: assignment to system variables other than @@dataset_id and @@dataset_project_id. |
| `EXECUTE IMMEDIATE` | Partial | See [Scripts and transactions](compatibility.md#scripts-and-transactions). Unsupported: scripting statements in EXECUTE IMMEDIATE. |
| Transactions | Partial | See [Scripts and transactions](compatibility.md#scripts-and-transactions). Unsupported: committing a transaction after a handled error; roll it back instead. |
| `CALL` | Partial | See [Stored procedures](compatibility.md#stored-procedures). Unsupported: function declarations, system variable assignments, dynamic SQL and query parameters inside procedures. |
